01

Too much market data, too little explained evidence

Problem statement and the solution we built for it.

The business problem

Investors and traders struggle to:

Find relevant themesAcross about 2,580 NSE-listed equities, while sector leadership rotates every few weeks.
Read F&O activityWhich contracts see new longs, new shorts, short covering or unwinding, and how FIIs, DIIs and prop desks are positioned.
Hold management to accountChecking last quarter's earnings-call promises means reading two long transcripts side by side.
Trust AI analysisGeneric AI tools often invent numbers, sources or dates.

Our solution

An agent workforce on a deterministic data core. Each agent has one job and one evidence base:

Data agentsPull from the NSE MCP servers first, then Zerodha Kite and Tickertape MCP to fill gaps, recording source and timestamp for every value.
Screening and theme agentsRank instruments on a five-pillar, equal-weight score and 70 built-in or plain-language custom themes.
Derivatives and flows agentsClassify OI buildup across 200+ stock and index futures and show participant positions and FII/DII flows.
Research and concall agentsUse an LLM only to interpret supplied evidence. Every citation and quote is checked against what was actually retrieved.

Scope delivered: futures open interest, buildup, participant positions and FII/DII flows, all from official NSE files. Options-chain analytics such as PCR and Gamma Exposure, and an Agentforce front end over the same API, are the next build steps.

What the app does today

Overview and market desk

Nifty 50, Sensex and Nifty Bank with day range and as-of time; NSE session band; breadth; sector quadrants; watchlist highlights.

Ask the market

Plain-English questions become a validated filter DSL. The model never writes SQL and never supplies a price.

Whole-market screener

About 2,580 NSE equities: filter builder, sortable columns, saved screens and CSV export with source and as-of metadata.

Theme screener

70 themes across momentum, low risk, quality, value, contrarian, income, growth and financial strength. Monthly snapshots are never overwritten.

Five-pillar score

Fundamentals, valuation, price action, risk and market context, 20% each, ranked against peers. Missing metrics are disclosed, never scored as zero.

Sector rotation

22 NSE sectors against Nifty 50 on a smoothed relative rotation graph with trails, replay and a quadrant roster. Refreshed every 12 hours.

F&O and open interest

Long and short buildup, short covering and long unwinding from NSE's F&O bhavcopy; live OI from Kite before NSE publishes.

FII / DII flows

Daily cash flows, NSDL FPI history and participant-wise index-futures positions for FII, DII, Pro and Client.

Concall follow-through

Reads transcripts filed with NSE, checks last quarter's commitments against this quarter's call and the news, and scores follow-through 0–100.

Research board and entry setup

Pros, cons, catalysts and risks from retrieved evidence; entry state with every rule that passed or failed.

Market news and macro

NSE announcements with the move since the news; crude, DXY, USD/INR, US yields and India CPI with a rule-based risk regime.

Watchlists, alerts and assistant

Watchlists, in-app alerts on price, indicators, themes, filings and quadrant changes, and a chat assistant that routes to the right page.

03

Four flows, from exchange file to explained answer

Each flow runs on a schedule or on a user request. Steps run in order.

ANightly market ingestion

  1. Scheduler fires at 19:30 IST on weekdaysOne run at a time; a duplicate request is recorded as skipped.
  2. Fetch from NSE MCPBhavcopy prices and corporate actions. “Session not found” replies are resent on the same session, then on a new one.
  3. Fall back and reconcileKite MCP fills gaps. Disagreements beyond tolerance are stored and shown, and NSE wins.
  4. Adjust and storeSplits and bonuses are back-adjusted; raw and normalised rows go to PostgreSQL with provider and retrieval time.
  5. Recompute and refreshMetrics, scores and theme members are recomputed and the cache is cleared. A failed run keeps the last good snapshot.

BF&O positioning

  1. Download NSE F&O and participant-OI filesAny past date can be fetched from NSE's archive.
  2. Aggregate futures per underlyingOI is summed across expiries, so a roll does not look like unwinding.
  3. Classify buildupPrice up, OI up: long buildup. Price down, OI up: short buildup. Price up, OI down: short covering. Price down, OI down: long unwinding.
  4. Go live before NSE publishesLive OI and prices from Kite are compared with the last published file, and the page says so.
  5. Show participant positionsFII, DII, Pro and Client index-futures long and short sit beside daily cash flows.

CStock research request

  1. Resolve the instrumentBy exchange and symbol or ISIN; limited to 6 requests per minute.
  2. Assemble evidenceLatest quote, statements and metrics, plus web sources with URL, publication date and retrieval time.
  3. Scrub, then promptRetrieved text is treated as data; injected instructions are removed before the model sees it.
  4. Validate the replySchema check, one repair retry, then grounding: every cited source must have been retrieved.
  5. Show facts, calculations and interpretation apartWithout a model, a rule-based summary appears and says so.

DConcall follow-through

  1. Fetch the last four transcripts filed with NSEOr upload a PDF or text file for a call NSE does not have.
  2. Extract last quarter's commitmentsThe LLM lists each commitment with category, importance and target.
  3. Assess against this quarter and the webDelivered, partly delivered, in progress, deferred, not delivered or not addressed.
  4. Ground every quoteA quote not found verbatim in the transcript removes the item from the score.
  5. Score with concall-v1Sum of importance × credit, divided by total importance, × 100 (high 3, medium 2, low 1). Fewer than 3 grounded items gives no score.

Backtest: trading on the news signal for one week

If you had acted on every decisive news signal from the app's model during the last week, with a take-profit and a stop-loss on each trade, what would it have returned? Every figure is simulated on real NSE daily prices.

How the backtest works

  • Data. News: NSE corporate announcements and web headlines from 23 to 29 October 2026, taken from the live app's news feed. Prices: NSE bhavcopy daily open, high, low and close (5 entry prices came from Kite MCP).
  • Signal. The app's news model (news-sentiment-v1, news tone only). It reads an order win, buyback, dividend, acquisition or capacity addition as positive, and a resignation, regulatory action, litigation or insolvency as negative. Each stock's first decisive item is used. The price-reaction part of the model is left out because it already contains the outcome.
  • Placing a trade. Entry is the first NSE close after the news was published; news after 15:30 IST enters at the next day's close. Stocks with no full session before 29 October (81) or no price history (10) are skipped.
  • Closing a trade. Each following day is checked against its high and low. The stop loss is checked before the take profit; if both levels fall within one day, the stop is assumed to have hit first, because daily bars cannot show which came first. A day that opens beyond a level exits at the open. Trades still open exit at the 29 October close.
  • Best values. Every take profit from 1% to 15% and stop loss from 1% to 10% (steps of 0.5%), plus “off”, was tried at 0.25% costs. The combination with the highest average return is the “best”. It is fitted to this same week, so it flatters the result; the box above shows how it did on trades it had not seen.
  • Market comparison. For every trade, Nifty 50 is measured from the entry day's close to the close of the day the trade exits. Nifty 50 closed at 22,600.00 on 23 Oct and 22,936.75 on 29 Oct (NSE CM market MCP), so the market rose 1.49% over the week. With the hedge on, each trade also sells Nifty 50 futures of equal value (or buys them against a short), so the result is the stock's move beyond the market, less an extra 0.05% cost. The hedge closes at that day's Nifty close.
  • Money. The amount is split equally across the trades shown, with no leverage. Selling on negative news assumes a stock-futures or borrowed short, because cash-market shorts cannot be held overnight in India. Slippage beyond the cost setting, taxes and lot sizes are ignored.
  • Limits. One week and 127 trades show how the signal behaved, not how it will behave. The LLM's research stances were not stored point-in-time, so they cannot be backtested yet.
07

How each judging criterion is met

Weights come from section 9 of the Participant Guidelines. Each area lists what we built and where a judge can verify it.

15%Business value

Business value and problem relevance

  • Targets the stated problem directly: theme discovery, F&O activity and institutional positioning for Indian markets.
  • Adds concall follow-through, a check analysts do by hand today.
  • Stays a research tool: no orders and no advice; stances are labelled as research classifications.
Overview, Themes, F&O, Flows and Concall pages · README features
15%Functionality

Functional completeness and reliability

  • 14 working pages on live NSE data; all nine plan phases are done.
  • Resilience: retries, circuit breakers, NSE → Kite → stored-data fallbacks, last good snapshots kept on failure, and outages never cached as values.
  • Verified live: NSE MCP (36 tools), the full-market pipeline, and web research. The language model runs on Azure OpenAI, called only from the server.
PLAN.md status · connectors/mcp_client.py · tests/connectors/test_real_contracts.py
15%Team mix

Teams formed with mixed practices (Agentforce × Data & AI)

  • The team spans data and AI engineering, quality testing and cloud deployment.
  • The versioned /api/v1 contract and MCP tool layer are built so Agentforce actions can call the same agents.
Team section · backend/app/api/v1
10%Accessibility

Accessibility and inclusive design

  • Keyboard navigation with a / search shortcut, labelled controls, visible focus, light and dark themes, desktop and mobile layouts.
  • Clear states: skeleton loaders, actionable errors with request IDs, and “missing” or “stale” labels instead of zeros.
  • Playwright end-to-end tests run on desktop and mobile viewports.
frontend/src/components/ui.tsx · frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts
10%Security

Cybersecurity and data protection

  • Secrets stay server-side: .env is git-ignored, Azure secrets live in Key Vault, CI signs in with OIDC, and only .env.example is committed.
  • Read-only broker access: Kite tools outside a 7-tool allowlist are refused before any request is sent.
  • LLM guardrails: prompt-injection guard, schema validation and citation grounding; a validated filter DSL instead of model-written SQL.
  • Optional bearer token, per-endpoint rate limits, audit events, and pip-audit and npm audit in CI.
core/prompt_guard.py · connectors/kite_mcp.py · infra/azure/configure.sh
10%Innovation

Innovation and differentiation

  • The concall follow-through score is a reproducible measure of whether management delivered, grounded in verbatim quotes.
  • The LLM never supplies a number; every figure comes from versioned, unit-tested code with its formula and inputs available.
  • Live MCP tool discovery, field-level provenance and NSE-versus-broker conflict display.
domain/concall_score.py · domain/provenance.py · domain/reconcile.py
10%Data & AI

Effective use of Agentforce and/or Data & AI

  • Data engineering: multi-source MCP ingestion, XBRL parsing, split adjustment, percentile scoring, rotation and OI analytics.
  • AI: plain language to DSL, grounded research, theme refinement, concall classification and an assistant, each with a rule-based fallback.
  • Usage tracking of tokens, cost and model ID per call, under daily budgets.
services/research.py, ask.py, theme_ai.py, concall.py, assistant.py
10%Scale and GTM

Scalability and go-to-market potential

  • Stateless API, a separate worker, Redis locks and idempotent jobs, so replicas can be added.
  • Two container images; Azure Container Apps CI/CD with health-checked rollout and automatic rollback; AWS and GCP recipes.
  • Other exchanges plug in as provider adapters, and the schema already models commodities.
.github/workflows/ci.yml · infra/azure/deploy.sh · analysis/RUN_AND_DEPLOY.md
